candidates.name: Association of Orthodox Parishes in Norway under the Archdiocese in Paris
candidates.reason: The Norwegian register confirms the current association, but the official Archdiocese directory directly identifies only its Bergen and Oslo parishes. The civil association is not published as a separate ecclesial body until the Archdiocese names it among its own.

candidates.name: Ukrainian Orthodox Community of Holy Yaroslav the Wise in Trondelag
candidates.reason: The Norwegian register confirms the current legal body, but neither an official UOC source nor an official OCU source identifies its canonical parent. It must not be assigned by ethnicity or name alone.

candidates.name: Ukrainian Orthodox Community of Archangel Michael in Forsand
candidates.reason: The current Norwegian register confirms a Ukrainian Orthodox legal body founded in 2026, but the name and record do not identify UOC, OCU, or another canonical parent.

candidates.name: Ukrainian Orthodox Parish of the Holy Apostles Peter and Paul in Haugesund
candidates.reason: The active Norwegian legal body and worship address are current, but neither the official UOC Norway directory nor an official OCU source identifies its canonical parent.

candidates.name: Bulgarian Orthodox Parish of St John of Rila in Bergen
candidates.reason: The Norwegian register confirms the legal body, but the current Bulgarian Patriarchate directory lists only the Saints Cyril and Methodius community in Oslo for Norway. No official diocesan source was found for the Bergen body.

candidates.name: Protection of the Mother of God Orthodox Parish in Sandnes
candidates.reason: The legal body remains active. A 2009 publication of Holy Nicholas Parish listed it in Sandnes, but the current Holy Nicholas parish site no longer does, and no other current official church source establishes its parentage.

candidates.name: Annunciation Orthodox Monastery in Tvedestrand
candidates.reason: The monastery and legal body are current, but the only jurisdictional source found identifies it with the Russian Church Abroad under Metropolitan Agafangel, outside the recognized canonical jurisdictions in scope.

candidates.name: Namsos Orthodox Church
candidates.reason: The Norwegian legal name is generic and no official canonical Eastern Orthodox parent was found. Available civil details indicate an East African community, so it cannot be assigned to an Eastern Orthodox jurisdiction without direct church evidence.

candidates.name: Cooperation Association for Orthodox Faithful in Norway
candidates.status: not published as an ecclesial body
candidates.reason: The Norwegian register confirms an active religious association, but no official canonical jurisdiction identifies it as a diocese, parish, mission, chapel, monastery, metochion, or subordinate worship site.

candidates.name: Makedonska Vistinska Pravoslavna Crkva
candidates.reason: The Norwegian legal body is separate from the St Petka community documented by the canonical Macedonian Orthodox Church European Diocese. No official Macedonian Orthodox Church source recognizes this body.

candidates.name: Russian Orthodox Catacomb Church Outside Russia
candidates.reason: The current Norwegian legal body is not documented under the Moscow Patriarchate, ROCOR, or another recognized canonical Eastern Orthodox authority. Its own name describes a separate catacomb body.

candidates.name: Monastery of St Olav and the Prophet Elijah in Valldal
candidates.reason: The Norwegian register describes a Serbian Orthodox connection, but the monastery is absent from the current official Serbian diocesan sources checked and its current site does not name a canonical parent. Publication waits for a direct current church source.

candidates.name: Theophany Parish in Bergen
candidates.reason: The current Moscow Patriarchate Norway page says the body withdrew from the Russian Orthodox Church. No current official canonical parent was found.

candidates.name: Former Moscow Patriarchate activity in Tromso
candidates.reason: Historical activity was reported, but no current Tromso parish or mission appears in the official Norway parish navigation or current deanery material.

candidates.name: Proposed Transfiguration Hermitage in Arendal
candidates.reason: The official parish page describes the hermitage as a future possibility. The existing private house chapel is published, but the proposed hermitage is not an established body or site.

candidates.name: Possible Romanian monastic body at Nodeland
candidates.status: hold for name and legal identity
candidates.reason: The official diocesan map marks the Nodeland location as monastic and names a nun, but it gives no separate monastery name. The published Kristiansand parish remains the only named body at the address.

candidates.name: Former Georgian monastic community in Valldal
candidates.reason: The current Georgian Patriarchate material checked does not document a Norway body, and the current Valldal monastery site does not claim Georgian jurisdiction. Historical affiliation is not current canonical parentage.

candidates.name: Former Georgian monastic presence on Selja
candidates.reason: No current officially documented Georgian jurisdiction or subordinate body on Selja was found. Historical residence or service does not establish a present directory row.
